headlines.title: Bob Dylan comes knockin' on pope's door as Leo welcomes legend to Vatican
headlines.summary: The American singer-songwriter and poet visited with the American pope at the Vatican during a break between concert dates in Italy. The Vatican said the encounter was brief.

headlines.title: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 years in prison
headlines.summary: Wong was sentenced for his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law, in a case that critics say reflects the crackdown on the city's once-thriving pro-democracy movement.

headlines.title: Where voters stand on state ballot measures, from abortion to LGBTQ rights to guns
headlines.summary: Voters in dozens of states considered 146 statewide ballot measures this midterm cycle, on topics spanning LGBTQ rights, wealth taxes, abortion, redistricting, guns and more.

headlines.title: Elon Musk will face scrutiny from Democrats after midterms

headlines.title: Democratic leaders reflect on midterm results and what's next for the party
headlines.summary: Democratic party leaders and political analysts spoke with Morning Edition about the results of the midterm elections, the effects of mid-decade redistricting efforts, and the next steps for the party.

headlines.title: Democrats ride blue wave to Congress in midterm polls
headlines.summary: Democrats are projected to flip control of the US Senate after winning several key races in battleground states, securing control of both chambers of Congress in the midterm polls, election forecasting agency Decision Desk HQ said late Tuesday.

headlines.title: Democratic wave reshapes Washington, policy shifts uncertain
headlines.summary: Democrats' sweeping victories in Tuesday's midterm elections have shifted the balance of power in Washington, setting up two years of divided government. Analysts say the new congressional majorities will bring stronger scrutiny of President Donald Trump's administration, although their ability to change his domestic and foreign policies remains uncertain.

headlines.title: Envoy calls for stable Sino-US relations
headlines.summary: Chinese Ambassador to the United States Xie Feng called for steady, sound and sustainable China-US relations, emphasizing the importance of cooperation and the consistency of China's policy toward the United States, while also discussing the Communist Party of China's self-governance and China's contributions to global development.

headlines.title: Intl observers laud plenum communique
headlines.summary: Political observers and scholars in Europe have shared their views on Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building and its implications for China's governance and long-term development following the fifth plenary session of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

headlines.title: Tehran says reignited conflict would benefit no one
headlines.summary: Amid fears of fresh US strikes on Iran after the midterm elections, Tehran has warned that renewed all-out conflict would benefit no one, saying the onus is on Washington to avert such a scenario.

hackerNews.title: Want to Rent an Internet Address at the White House?
hackerNews.summary: Several staffers at the White House are using computers or mobile devices equipped with residential proxy services that render their internet address available for others to rent, security experts warned today.
